C. I D.
No. 1094
28/4/7
Shanghai Municipal Council.
April 19th 1917

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
D.S.Schmidt reports that he saw Ettinger
on April 18th at 9 p.m. on the North Szechuen
Road with something bulky in his hip pocket.
Ettinger when he saw the D.S. got into
a ricsha and went away in the direction of
the Hongkew Park.
The D.S. asks for instructions as to
whether he would be justified in searching
Ettinger if he met him again under similar
conditions.
Ettinger is not on the list of Germans
registered at the Bureau of Foreign Affairs.
He is a Turkish Jew and has been until
recently under the protection of the German
Consulate.

Your Obedient Servant,
Muirhead Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

CM
On report
arrest & search
Station & Court
to
M
Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
C. I D.
第 1094 号
28/4/7
上海工部局。
1917年4月19日

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处。
（侦探股。）

先生，
施密特侦探长（D.S. Schmidt）报告称，他于4月18日晚9时在四川北路看见艾廷格（Ettinger），其臀部口袋中装有体积庞大的物品。
艾廷格见到该侦探长后，即乘人力车向虹口公园方向离去。
该侦探长请示，若他在类似情况下再次遇见艾廷格，是否有理由对其实施搜查。
艾廷格未列入外事局登记的德国人名册。
他是土耳其籍犹太人，直至最近一直受德国领事馆保护。

您顺从的仆人，
缪尔黑德·阿姆斯特朗
首席侦探督察

CM
阅悉报告
逮捕并搜查
警局及法庭
致
M
警务处总监
